description: This file implements a filesystem abstraction for ZIP archives used in gettext localization, including functions for loading message and resource files, listing locales, and deriving file names within ZIP archives.

classes.name: zipFS
classes.description: A filesystem abstraction over a ZIP archive for gettext localization files.

methods.name: newZipFS
methods.description: Constructor for zipFS, initializes root directory based on ZIP contents.

methods.name: zipName
methods.description: Returns the base name of the ZIP file without extension.

methods.name: zipRoot
methods.description: Determines the root directory for localization files within the ZIP archive.

methods.name: LocaleList
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of available locale names in the ZIP archive.

methods.name: LoadMessagesFile
methods.description: Loads a message file for a given domain, language, and extension from the ZIP archive.

methods.name: LoadResourceFile
methods.description: Loads a resource file for a given domain, language, and filename from the ZIP archive.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the zipFS instance.

methods.name: makeMessagesFileName
methods.description: Constructs the filename for a message file within the ZIP archive.

methods.name: makeResourceFileName
methods.description: Constructs the filename for a resource file within the ZIP archive.

methods.name: lsZip
methods.description: Lists locales available in the ZIP archive based on directory structure.
